# What a browser measured: the kern of every ordered pair of printable
# ASCII that kerns at all, in the faces this crate serves, at 12 px.
#
# Source: the De Bruijn sweep in reports/specimens, read out of
# /usr/bin/google-chrome (Google Chrome 152.0.7977.64) on 2026-09-05, one 9026-character text node per face
# holding every one of the 9025 ordered pairs exactly once. The kern is
# the step between consecutive character positions less the character's
# own advance. Pairs whose kern is under a sixty-fourth of a pixel, the
# grid the engine rounds to, are not listed.
#
# This is committed so the generator can be held to what a browser
# really did rather than to its own arithmetic. reports/ is not in the
# repository, so a test that read it there would quietly stop testing.
#
# Format: face, the two characters, the kern in CSS pixels at 12 px.
# The pair is written as two characters after a single space, so a pair
# containing a space is unambiguous.
